Copied on 16 November 2026 from the owner's local `Data/` folder, where they were made with SSM mTool v2.2 for the fictional company Test Sdn Bhd (012345678910). No real client data.

| File | Source | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `blank-first-return.xlsx` | `AR1-Test_Sdn_Bhd-12345678910-01112025.xlsx` | Blank AR1, first return made up to 1 Nov 2025, private company |
| `blank-second.xlsx` | `AR1-Test_2_Sdn_Bhd-12345678910-30122025.xlsx` | Blank AR1 for Test 2 Sdn Bhd (public company); used as a mismatched blank |
| `allrows-mtool.xlsx` | `AR1-Test_Sdn_Bhd-ALLROWS-MTOOL.xlsx` | mTool's own output after Typed Domain added two rows to each table in `adds-all.json` |
| `handfill.xlsx` | `AR1-Test_Sdn_Bhd-HANDFILL.xlsx` | Partly filled by hand in mTool, for reading stored value forms |
